findings.title: Same-domain check misses website subdomains such as www.example.com
findings.body: The `else` branch only treats the user's website domain as a parent/suffix of the Discourse host (`discourse_host.ends_with?("." << website_host)`). It does not handle the reverse case where the website is a subdomain of the Discourse host. For example, with `Discourse.current_hostname == 'example.com'` and `website == 'http://www.example.com/user'`, `website_name` returns `'www.example.com'` and drops `/user`, even though the sibling-subdomain logic indicates subdomains of the same registrable domain should show the path. This makes the new UX fail for the common bare-apex vs `www` configuration.

findings.title: `include_website_name` is misnamed and dead code
findings.body: Serializer inclusion callbacks use `include_website_name?` with a trailing question mark, and `untrusted_attributes` already defines that callback for `:website_name`. Defining `include_website_name` without `?` has no effect. It should be removed; simply renaming it to `include_website_name?` would override the untrusted guard and could expose `website_name` to restricted anonymous TL0 users.

findings.title: TL0 anonymous untrusted attribute list not updated
findings.body: `website_name` was added to the serializer's `untrusted_attributes` list, but the local `untrusted_attributes` array in the TL0 anonymous test still omits `:website_name`. The current test would pass even if `website_name` were exposed because no `website` is set in that context. Add a profile website and assert that `json` does not have `:website_name`.
